name: Forge
text: Build a public npm package called "claude-skill-creator" that lets users customize any Claude skill with a simple UI. This lowers the barrier for creators to tweak skills without coding, aligning with the goal of expanding UGC. The trade-off is that we’re not building a full IDE—this is a focused tool for quick edits, not deep customization.

name: Vet
text: The real risk is that a "simple UI" for skill customization will either be too limited to satisfy real creators or too complex for non-technical users—both wasting effort. A better alternative is to first build a minimal CLI tool that exposes the core customization logic, then add a UI layer only if user feedback proves demand. Settle it by running a quick survey: if 80% of potential users say they’d use a CLI over a UI, we pivot.
